description: The window.SITE_CONFIG value in site/data/site.js. See docs/init-list.md.

name.description: Franchise display name, e.g. "Final Fantasy". Also the default source for a derived storagePrefix when that field is omitted.

tagline.description: Flat parts array (no paragraph/`{parts}` envelope) rendered under the page heading.

description.description: Plain string for <meta name="description">. Omit to fall back to `tagline` flattened to plain text.

lastUpdated.description: ISO date. Omit for no "Last Updated" line.

foundingYear.description: Footer copyright start year. Defaults to 2026 when omitted.

entities.description: Who the footer's "Not affiliated with ___" disclaimer names, e.g. ["Square Enix"].

license.description: Flat parts array, same shape as `tagline`. Omit for the default CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 line.

noticeUrl.description: Link to this repo's NOTICE.md. Omit for no "See NOTICE..." sentence.

storagePrefix.description: Literal localStorage key prefix for every visitor's saved checklist/theme/display preferences. Load-bearing once a repo has visitors -- get it right once and never change it, or existing saved data is silently orphaned. Omit only for a brand-new repo with no visitors yet (a deterministic default is derived from `name`).

discussionsUrl.description: This repo's GitHub Discussions URL. Read directly by kit's common-faq.js ("help-improve"/"fan-art" answers), not just by page.dc.html.

disclosures.description: Extra footer paragraphs, same dual string|{parts} shape as CREDITS.
